name: quark-onnx-doc-drift-check
description: Compare ONNX skill contracts and guidance against current Quark ONNX documentation and source entry points. Use when maintainers need to verify that ONNX install docs, custom-op registry, QConfig fields, preset and calibration lists, AutoSearchPro presets, deployment-target gates, or example-script invocations still match upstream Quark ONNX reality. Trigger for "check ONNX doc drift", "are ONNX skills still accurate", "verify against Quark ONNX docs", "fact-check quark-onnx-* skills", or after a Quark release when upstream ONNX documentation may have changed.
